checks: Independent narrow EDF+ TAL decoding versus the established reader path, including the seven compatibility cases
PSG/Hypnogram fixed-header and Recordingfield pair-date equality without rewriting the seven differing within-file date interpretations
Independent 30-second boundary-partition projection versus every frozen truth grid's epoch indices, onsets, labels and validity masks

execution.python_environment: isolated research Python 3.11 with pyEDFlib 0.1.42 and MNE 1.8.0; the smaller public audit environment does not include MNE

privacy: Aggregate counts and content hashes only; no recording IDs, source paths, EDF headers, annotations, raw signal values, truth arrays or participant assignments are published.
limitations: This verifies reader interpretation and frozen epoch accounting; it does not establish independent clinical scoring or whole-night observation boundaries.
PSG waveform calibration and full PSG source-byte verification are inherited from earlier readiness and publisher-content checks, not repeated here.
A public clone cannot rerun this crosscheck without authorized original EDFs and the protected frozen truth arrays.
